title: Implement approved event card
brief: Implement this already-approved event card as a standalone HTML file. The design decisions below are final.
context: White background, #18212B text, #0B5D4B primary button, 16px system body text, 24px title, 24px card padding, 12px corner radius. Order: category Community; title Repair Together; date Saturday 10:00–14:00; location South Workshop; primary button Reserve a place. Card max width 480px, fluid below that with 16px page padding. Button opens an inline confirmation reading Place reserved. No images.
constraints: Implement the supplied order, copy and tokens.
At 390px wide, all card content remains within the page.

checks.criterion: Implements all specified colors, type sizes, padding, radius and maximum width.
Category, title, date, location and button appear in the specified order.
Reserve a place reveals Place reserved without navigating to a missing page.
Does not ask the user to reselect colors, audience, layout or design direction already supplied.
